g.text: Part 1: Two Patterns to Authenticate Users from a Custom UI to :streamAssist
Pattern 1A (Pure Google Identity) · Pattern 1B (Workforce Identity Federation + Google STS) · IAM Role & GE License
Zero Static Service Account JSON Keys · Direct User or Workforce Principal
